generation.scope: All four-finite-edge Frobenius candidates with an embedding-dimension-three local point have a canonical four-periodic marked point and a free indexed Ore presentation over a ternary quadratic graded algebra. The candidate is standard AS if and only if its base is Koszul AS3 of polynomial Hilbert series. For each such base a stabilized subquotient of its 18-dimensional space of quadratic corrections computes all marked extensions, indexed isomorphism and shift; unmarked comparison tries at most two points.

open_mathematics: For a ternary quantum polynomial base, decompose the linear parameter space into multidegrees and compute which commutation parameters can give a finite edge. Determine all resonances, the finite-edge inequalities, unmarked indexed isomorphisms and period strata. For other AS3 bases evaluate the same linear relation; embedding-dimension-two points and the unrestricted non-Ore locus are open. For the ordinary rank-15 curve resolve the residual four-cut rank locus beyond the existing length-13 branch test.
